audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra bodily discharge text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for male discharge, semen emission, menstruation, abnormal female discharge, washing/waiting, offerings, and sanctuary protection. Strong anti-body-shame and anti-sex-shame safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: Any man, when discharge flows from his flesh, his discharge is unclean.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

modern.text: “Say to the Israelites, ‘When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.

original.text: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זוֹב֖וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא

verses.restored: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his flesh runs with discharge or his flesh is stopped from discharge, it is his uncleanness.

familiar.text: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

modern.text: This uncleanness is from his discharge, whether his body allows the discharge to flow or blocks it. So his discharge will bring about uncleanness.

original.text: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖וֹ בְּזוֹב֑וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ הִֽוא

verses.restored: Every bed on which one with discharge lies shall be unclean, and every vessel on which he sits shall be unclean.

familiar.text: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

modern.text: Any bed on which the man with the discharge lies will be unclean, and any furniture on which he sits will be unclean.

original.text: כָּל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: A man who touches his bed shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: One who sits on vessel on which one with discharge sat shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: One who touches flesh of one with discharge shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: If one with discharge spits on clean one, then he shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכִֽי יָרֹ֛ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Every saddle on which one with discharge rides shall be unclean.

familiar.text: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

modern.text: Any saddle on which the man with the discharge rides will be unclean.

original.text: וְכָל הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: Everyone touching anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening; one carrying them shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכָל הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Everyone whom one with discharge touches without rinsing hands in water shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands with water, the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Earthen vessel touched by one with discharge shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed in water.

familiar.text: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

modern.text: Any clay pot that the man with the discharge touches must be broken, and any wooden utensil must be rinsed with water. The Cleansing of Men

original.text: וּכְלִי חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל כְּלִי עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: When one with discharge becomes clean from his discharge, he shall count seven days for his cleansing, wash garments, wash flesh in living water, and be clean.

familiar.text: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

modern.text: When the man has been cleansed from his discharge, he must count off seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe himself in fresh water, and he shall be clean.

original.text: וְכִֽי יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר

verses.restored: On eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon, come before YHWH to entrance of tent of meeting, and give them to priest.

familiar.text: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

modern.text: On the eighth day he is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, come before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

original.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל פֶּ֨תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: Priest shall offer them, one as sin/purification offering and one as burnt offering; priest shall make atonement/covering for him before YHWH from his discharge.

familiar.text: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

modern.text: The priest is to sacrifice them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man before the LORD because of his discharge.

original.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ

verses.restored: When emission of seed goes out from a man, he shall wash all his flesh in water and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Every garment and every skin on which emission of seed is shall be washed in water and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Any clothing or leather on which there is an emission of semen must be washed with water, and it will remain unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכָל בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: A woman with whom a man lies with emission of seed, both shall wash in water and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening. The Uncleanness of Women

original.text: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: When a woman has discharge, blood being her discharge in her flesh, seven days she shall be in her menstruation/separation; everyone touching her shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: When a woman has a discharge consisting of blood from her body, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Everything on which she lies in her menstruation/separation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.

familiar.text: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

modern.text: Anything on which she lies or sits during her menstruation will be unclean,

original.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: Everyone touching her bed shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכָל הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Everyone touching any vessel on which she sits shall wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְכָל הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: If it is on bed or on vessel on which she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

modern.text: And whether it is a bed or furniture on which she was sitting, whoever touches it will be unclean until evening.

original.text: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: If lying, a man lies with her, and her menstruation/separation is upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

familiar.text: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

modern.text: If a man lies with her and her menstrual flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies will become unclean.

original.text: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא

verses.restored: When a woman has discharge of her blood many days not in time of her menstruation/separation, or when she has flow beyond her menstruation/separation, all days of flow of her uncleanness shall be as days of her menstruation/separation; she is unclean.

familiar.text: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

modern.text: When a woman has a discharge of her blood for many days at a time other than her menstrual period, or if it continues beyond her period, she will be unclean all the days of her unclean discharge, just as she is during the days of her menstruation.

original.text: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי תָז֖וּב עַל נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא

verses.restored: Every bed on which she lies all days of her discharge shall be to her like bed of her menstruation/separation; every vessel on which she sits shall be unclean, like uncleanness of her menstruation/separation.

familiar.text: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

modern.text: Any bed on which she lies or any furniture on which she sits during the days of her discharge will be unclean, like her bed during her menstrual period.

original.text: כָּל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ

verses.restored: Everyone touching them shall be unclean, wash garments, wash in water, and be unclean until evening.

familiar.text: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

modern.text: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening. The Cleansing of Women

original.text: וְכָל הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: If she is clean from her discharge, she shall count for herself seven days, and afterward be clean.

familiar.text: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

modern.text: When a woman is cleansed of her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

original.text: וְאִֽם טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר

verses.restored: On eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon and bring them to priest, to entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: On the eighth day she is to take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Priest shall offer one as sin/purification offering and one as burnt offering; priest shall make atonement/covering for her before YHWH from discharge of her uncleanness.

familiar.text: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.

modern.text: The priest is to sacrifice one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her before the LORD for her unclean discharge.

original.text: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ

verses.restored: You shall separate children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they do not die in their uncleanness by making unclean my dwelling-place that is in their midst.

familiar.text: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

modern.text: You must keep the children of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die by defiling My tabernacle, which is among them.

original.text: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֨תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction for one with discharge, for one from whom emission of seed goes out, becoming unclean by it,

familiar.text: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

modern.text: This is the law of him who has a discharge, of the man who has an emission of semen whereby he is unclean,

original.text: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶ֖רַע לְטָמְאָה בָֽהּ

verses.restored: and for one sick/menstruating in her menstruation/separation, and for one with flow of discharge, male or female, and for man who lies with unclean woman.

familiar.text: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

modern.text: of a woman in her menstrual period, of any male or female who has a discharge, and of a man who lies with an unclean woman.’”

original.text: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת זוֹב֔וֹ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם טְמֵאָֽה

translation_notes: Bodily discharge impurity is ritual-state language, not moral shame or disgust.
Semen, menstruation, and genital discharges are treated as contact states affecting sanctuary approach, not as sin in themselves.
Both man and woman wash after intercourse with emission; do not single out women for shame.
Abnormal prolonged discharge receives offering after cleansing; this should not be used to shame illness.
Living water in v.13 suggests full embodied washing/restoration.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 15 for menstrual shame, sex shame, infertility shame, illness stigma, or disgust toward bodies. The chapter protects sanctuary boundaries through washing, waiting, and offerings; it does not declare bodies evil.
